info.title: OUT LMS — Enterprise REST & Web Services API
info.summary: Unified Academic, Administrative & Moodle Core Web Services Engine
info.description:
### 🏛️ The Open University of Tanzania (Chuo Kikuu Huria cha Tanzania)
**TCU & SARIS Accredited National Distance & Blended Learning Ecosystem**

Enterprise API Gateway documentation providing complete interactive visualization of:
1. **Public Academic & Discovery APIs**: Live course catalog, faculties, syllabi, fee structures, and verified instructor profiles.
2. **Admissions & Student Self-Service**: User registration, password resets, inquiries, and application workflows.
3. **Payments & Checkout Engine**: Pesapal 3.0 Mobile Money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Tigo Pesa, HaloPesa) & Card gateway.
4. **Accredited Digital Credentials**: SARIS & TCU verifiable digital certificates with unique verification codes.
5. **Course & Faculty Administration**: Full CUD operations for courses, learning activity modules, categories, and groups.
6. **Instructor Console Services**: Teaching dashboard, assignments, grading rubrics, quizzes, announcements, and earnings.
7. **System & Telemetry Operations**: Configuration, cache management, telemetry, and platform diagnostics.
8. **SSO & Authentication**: Single Sign-On and security token generation.
9. **Moodle Core Web Services**: Standard Moodle REST protocol endpoints (`/webservice/rest/server.php`).
